drills.title: Conjunction is commutative
hints: Theorem `and_commutative`: for propositions p and q taken as parameters, p ∧ q → q ∧ p, proved as a term.
Take the hypothesis `hpq : p ∧ q` by a lambda, annotating its type.
Introduce a local fact `hp : p`, obtained from hpq with And.left.
Introduce a local fact `hq : q`, obtained from hpq with And.right.
Finish by stating explicitly that the result proves q ∧ p, justified by And.intro applied to hq and hp.
